name: Circle of Power

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: you and your allies in the Emanation

summary: You and allies within 30 feet resist spells: Advantage on saves against them.
text: While in the Emanation, you and your allies have Advantage on saves against spells and other magical effects, and a success against such an effect that deals half damage on a success deals no damage instead.
